phase: Phase 1: SIH PS Requirements & System Scope
description: Formal engineering requirements specification derived from the Smart India Hackathon (SIH) Problem Statement with explicit basis classification.

classification_schema.PS_EXPLICIT: Directly stated as a core capability or expectation by the SIH Problem Statement.
classification_schema.ENGINEERING_DERIVED: Reasonable system architectural requirement derived to operationalize the PS.
classification_schema.DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE: BIS-specific domain knowledge the system must acquire dynamically from authorized BIS sources.

requirements.title: Indian Standards Question Answering
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Provide a specialized regulatory search and reasoning capability over Indian Standards (IS specifications, amendments, test methods, dimensional/chemical parameters, and revision history).
requirements.description: The assistant shall answer factual, technical, and regulatory questions concerning Indian Standards.

requirements.title: Applicable Standard Recommendation
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Enable natural language product identification and disambiguation so users without technical standard knowledge can discover applicable Indian Standards from descriptive queries.
requirements.description: The assistant shall recommend applicable Indian Standards based on user product descriptions, intended applications, manufacturing materials, and synonyms.

requirements.title: Certification Scheme Guidance
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Model the statutory conformity assessment schemes and Quality Control Orders (QCOs) to determine applicable certification pathways and mandatory vs voluntary legal status.
requirements.description: The assistant shall guide users regarding applicable BIS certification schemes and mandatory conformity requirements.

requirements.title: Certification Process Explanation
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Synthesize procedural documentation guidelines, factory audit requirements, and inspection schedules from official BIS Product Manuals and Schemes of Inspection and Testing.
requirements.description: The assistant shall explain the procedural steps, documentation, testing frequencies, and workflows required to obtain and maintain a BIS licence or registration.

requirements.title: Consumer Queries & Verification
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Provide verification lookup workflows against BIS operative licence, registration, and hallmarking registries, along with guidance on the BIS Care mobile portal and complaint redressal.
requirements.description: The assistant shall answer consumer-related queries, including verification of standard marks, licences, registrations, hallmarks, and reporting of counterfeit goods.

requirements.title: Hallmarking Guidance
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Incorporate precious metals purity standards, 6-digit Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) workflows, and directory routing for recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHCs).
requirements.description: The assistant shall guide users regarding gold and silver hallmarking processes, purity specifications, hallmark verification, and recognized assaying centers.

requirements.title: Testing Laboratories Lookup
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Index the official directory of accredited BIS Central, Regional, and partner laboratories with their approved testing scopes to route product queries to eligible test facilities.
requirements.description: The assistant shall suggest relevant BIS-recognized testing laboratories capable of testing products under specific Indian Standards.

requirements.title: Multilingual Interaction
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Integrate multilingual query understanding and localized explanation generation (starting with Hindi and English, architected for regional Indian languages) while preserving exact technical citations.
requirements.description: The assistant shall support multilingual interaction to ensure accessible communication for diverse stakeholders across India.

requirements.title: Authorized Knowledge Sources
requirements.capability: Ground All Responses in Authorized Sources
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Establish an authoritative corpus registry with cryptographic SHA-256 provenance tracking, rejecting unverified external data or ungrounded generative speculation.
requirements.description: All factual and regulatory answers generated by the assistant must be derived strictly from authorized BIS knowledge sources.

requirements.title: Source-Backed Responses & Citations
requirements.engineering_interpretation: Format every answer with granular references to governing documents, standard editions, gazette orders, clause numbers, and page locators appropriate to the query type.
requirements.description: The assistant shall provide references to relevant documents and specific clauses for all factual claims.
